title: GBAuto Agent OS delegation acknowledgement v1
description: The fast, non-blocking receipt the delegation seam emits the moment a source event arrives. The ack is conversation-free by contract: it states that the request was received and where it went, and it NEVER embeds work results (no result, output, answer, or artifact body properties exist, additionalProperties is false, and ack_text is capped at 300 characters). Structure alone is not enough, so scripts/delegation_router.py also lints ack_text against a completion-claim vocabulary and resolves delegation.dispatch_request_ref against the durable queue: an ack can neither assert finished work nor cite a request that was never composed. The ack is computable without resolving a specialist — specialist resolution happens after the ack and only fills delegation.specialist_expert / delegation.dispatch_request_ref on amendment. ADR-14 state semantics are TOTAL: delegation.status=blocked REQUIRES a blocker (failed dependency/validation with owner and next safe action) and EVERY other status (queued, direct_answer, gated) FORBIDS one — the if/then/else conditional below leaves no status unconstrained, so gated (ready, awaiting a valid approval capability) can never be conflated with blocked (failed).

source_event_id.description: The source-event.v1 identifier being acknowledged. A malformed envelope that carries no usable identifier is acknowledged under a derived src_unresolved_<digest> sentinel rather than being silently dropped.

ack_latency_ms.description: Real measured elapsed milliseconds between receipt and acknowledgement. The seam is non-blocking: this must stay inside the ack latency budget even when downstream specialist resolution is slow or fails.

ack_text.description: Bounded operator-facing acknowledgement sentence. Routing status only; never work output. Result-claiming prose (done/completed/merged/applied/deployed/ran/results/live/migration) is refused by delegation_router.ack_text_violations — the length cap bounds the damage, the vocabulary gate removes it.

conversation_free.description: Const true: the ack is a routing receipt, not a conversational answer, and carries no work results.

specialist_expert.description: Null until specialist resolution completes; resolution never happens on the ack path.

dispatch_request_ref.description: Null until a tac-dispatch-request.v1 has been composed and queued. Not merely pattern-shaped: delegation_router.validate_ack(ack, queue_root=...) resolves it against the durable queue, so a citation must name a request that really exists.

blocker.description: ADR-14 blocked semantics: a failed dependency or validation, named with its owner and the next safe action.
